editionLabel: Fantasy Flight Games second edition English rulebook, 2005
firstPlayerRule: Select one player at random to be the first player and give them the first player marker.
clarifications: During each phase, every player acts in turn, starting with the first player and continuing clockwise.
At the end of each game turn, after the Mythos Phase, the first player marker passes to the player on the left.
The first player also makes group decisions when players cannot agree, such as monster placement.

internalEvidence: Downloaded the rulebook from Fantasy Flight Games' own CDN and extracted text from PDF pages 2, 4, 5 and 12. Page 5 setup step 3: 'Select one player at random to be the first player. Give the first player marker to that player.' Page 5 The Game Turn: each phase starts with the first player and continues clockwise; the marker passes left at the end of each turn. Page 12 Turn End repeats the pass to the left. Copyright line reads 2005, 2006 Fantasy Flight Publishing; this is the FFG second edition (Richard Launius/Kevin Wilson), BGG 15987, not the 2018 third edition.
